name: pumi-launchpad
description: A tab that lists what you can open in it: whatever your plugins add to the + menu (a terminal, a page, an agent…), and the plugins themselves at the end. Pick one and it takes the tab's place. It ships with pumi and is what new tabs open.

images.alt: A new tab as the list of what it can open: a terminal, a page, an agent, each with its key
